observations: All sampled frames show a man in side profile holding a trumpet horizontally to his mouth. The bell, tubing, hands and head are recognizable enough for cartoon keydrawing references.
The sampled composition remains the same outdoor medium shot from 0.057 to 5.567 clip seconds. No scene transition is visible in the supplied samples.

The bell and hand silhouettes are readable; fine valve/finger detail is soft and hands partly overlap the tubing. Key drawings should preserve these visible contacts rather than invent hidden fingers.

proposed_interval.scene_boundaries: Conservative interior interval within the same sampled shot. No cut is observed in the 16 samples; exact shot boundaries and events between samples are unverified.
proposed_interval.purpose: Cartoon keydrawing pose references of the performer and trumpet.

limitations: Only timestamped stills were inspected, approximately 0.367 seconds apart. No motion, temporal continuity between samples, audio, performance timing or motion quality is approved.
